title: TrimMoE A communication aware and adaptive depth framework for distributed edge inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.00573v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Serving Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models across distributed edge servers is bottlenecked by the cross-server expert transmission. The existing approaches mainly focus on how to reach a remote expert faster. However, in this paper, we instead consider whether a given layer, and the layers after it, need to be executed at all. To this end, a communication-aware adaptive-depth framework is proposed in this paper, termed TrimMoE, which couples layer skipping and confidence-based early exit with substitute execution and server-expert selection under a unified quality budget. Specifically, in the offline stage, TrimMoE freezes the backbone, trains the lightweight per-layer exit heads, calibrates the per-layer importance thresholds, and allocates the expert replicas by a skip/exit-aware redundancy benefit. translated_title: TrimMoE：一种面向分布式边缘推理的通信感知自适应深度框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.00573v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：在分布式边缘服务器上服务混合专家（MoE）大型语言模型时，跨服务器专家传输成为瓶颈。现有方法主要关注如何更快地访问远程专家。然而，本文转而考虑给定层及其后续层是否完全需要执行。为此，本文提出了一种通信感知的自适应深度框架，称为TrimMoE，它在统一质量预算下，将层跳过和基于置信度的提前退出与替代执行及服务器专家选择相结合。具体而言，在离线阶段，TrimMoE冻结主干网络，训练轻量级的逐层退出头，校准逐层重要性阈值，并通过跳过/退出感知的冗余效益分配专家副本。在在线阶段，一种转换感知的前瞻机制预测令牌移动，从而使深度减少目标得以实现。
tldr: 本文提出TrimMoE框架，通过层跳过和置信度提前退出机制，在统一质量预算下优化分布式MoE模型的推理深度，从而减少跨服务器专家传输开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TrimMoE, a communication-aware adaptive-depth framework that reduces cross-server expert transmission overhead in distributed MoE inference by combining layer skipping and confidence-based early exit under a unified quality budget.
